decisiones.patron: 4 dos fallas, una vale la pena

decision_cruda.rationale: C590-09 is the richest stope (16.5 g/t, 256 t, about 136 oz). LH-01 is down until 12:30 to 14:30. LH-08 comes from the cheap infrastructure heading (0.4 oz/h, about 3 oz lost) and arrives at 09:59. LH-10 leaves PM at 10:00 and arrives at 10:20. Together they can muck the 256 t before 17:00, worth about 130 oz. C538-06 (6.9 g/t) is worth about 64 oz. LH-05 is likely back at 11:30, so it is not covered. LH-09 (critical path, 5.7 oz/h) stays put. Central has about 147 t of stockpile room and 91 t/h of truck capacity, so it is not truck-limited.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
